The issuer exhibits a solid balance sheet with a strong current ratio of 2.57 and a healthy equity-to-assets ratio of approximately 41% ($2,858M equity on $6,927M assets). However, profitability is relatively weak, characterized by a low operating margin of 6.4% and a thin net profit margin of 0.8% ($32M net income on $3,801M revenue). This combination of robust liquidity and capitalization but weak current profitability positions the issuer in the lower tier of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB-
